verdict.rationale: Bitbucket explicitly documents a free migration app to move code and users from Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Cloud, plus a matched free trial offer, directly addressing self-hosted-to-cloud migration. However, there's no evidence of tooling to migrate from other platforms (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, SVN), limiting the story's full scope to Bitbucket-to-Bitbucket migrations only.
